evidence: Has the Utils/log/libs label, introduces common/ecc_init, restructures ECC_Context lifecycle management, and bridges src/crypto/sha256 hardware acceleration into libsecp256k1.
rationale: Plugging hardware-accelerated SHA256 into libsecp256k1 provides durable cryptographic infrastructure improvements and measured performance gains. ECDSA signing time drops ~13-15% and Schnorr signing drops ~3-7% on CPUs with SHA extensions, while cleanly structuring context initialization for future modules like MuSig2 and BIP352.
